description: Records a new rule, architectural decision, error trap, or workflow. Automatically scrubs credentials.

assertion.description: Condition that keeps this memory relevant, checked against the working tree: text_present:<path>::<text>, symbol_present:<path>::<name>, or file_present:<path>. Once it stops holding, recall stops returning the memory.

content.description: Detailed actionable lesson or trap warning

module.description: Module name (e.g. auth, db, api, ui)

pinned.description: Pin to always surface during recall

scope.description: Storage scope: project-local or organization-wide global

verified.description: Set true if already verified by passing tests
